title: mockupMatrix
responsibility: Associate each authored option with the screenshots of its states and viewport widths.

inputs.name: mockupMatrix.context
inputs.description: Prepared Plan context with the renderer, progress emitter, and cancellation signal.

inputs.name: mockupMatrix.source
inputs.description: HTML and CSS for the default captures and requested states, including before documents where available.

inputs.name: mockupMatrix.prompt
inputs.description: Instruction recorded with the rendered design options.

outputs.name: mockupMatrix
outputs.description: Design options with ordered state and width screenshot artifacts.

errors.name: MockupFailure
errors.description: The requested capture count exceeds the limit or the renderer returned an incomplete set.
